use_case: AI credit underwriting model: the LOS vendor's AI credit scoring add-on scores online consumer auto and personal loan applications up to $25,000, recommends approve, refer, or decline, and supplies reason codes
vendor_or_model: LOS vendor's machine learning credit scoring model (vendor SaaS add-on to SYS-08)
data_categories: Credit report attributes; income and debt; employment length; membership tenure; share balances and deposit cash flow from the core; vehicle value; vendor digital identity signals (email and phone attributes)
human_in_the_loop: Scores above the approve cutoff are approved automatically; every refer and decline goes to the Lending Manager; from 2026-09-15 a second reviewer checks every model-recommended decline before the notice is sent
applicable_laws: ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.4(a), 1002.6, 1002.9); FCRA adverse action notice (15 U.S.C. 1681m(a)); GLBA and NCUA Part 748 App. A III.D (service provider oversight)

use_case: Online banking fraud scoring: the digital banking provider scores sign-ins and transfers and holds suspicious ones for review
vendor_or_model: Digital banking provider's fraud model (vendor SaaS, part of SYS-02)
data_categories: Sign-in device and location data; transaction history (member information)
consequential_decision_category: None (fraud holds are reviewed by staff; no credit decision)
human_in_the_loop: Operations Manager or an MSR reviews each held transaction and calls the member at the number on file
applicable_laws: GLBA and NCUA Part 748 App. A III.C.1.f and III.D; Regulation E error resolution for consumer transfers

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft letters or answer questions
data_categories: Risk of member information being pasted
applicable_laws: GLBA and NCUA Part 748 (entering member information would disclose it to an unapproved service provider)
